newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Norton McNaughton cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Norton McNaughton cut.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Wednesday it downgraded Norton McNaughton Inc to neutral from buy as the retail environment in moderate-priced women's apparel continues to be difficult.
-- Norton McNaughton said Tuesday that it expects net sales for the fiscal second quarter to be in line with expectations, or about $53.2 million, down from $57.4 million a year ago.

-- Rodman said it cut its third quarter earnings estimate for the comapny to $0.10 from $0.20 and its fourth quarter estimate to $0.30 from $0.39. Its fiscal 1997 estimate is $0.38 a share, down from $0.60, which compares with earnings of $0.20 in fiscal 1996.
